key_provisions_or_claims: Local governments bear primary responsibility for fire safety, with Party-government joint duty.
County fire rescue departments take territorial supervision; integrated prevention-and-rescue enforcement at township level.
Risk-graded differentiated supervision, with stricter inspection of high-risk sites.
Stronger product standards for e-bikes and lithium batteries, and mandatory certification of fire products.
Use of IoT, AI and big data for remote fire monitoring; fire credit supervision and public liability insurance.
annotation.summary_en: General Office of the State Council opinions (Guobanfa [2026] No. 6) on strengthening grassroots fire safety work: local responsibility, integrated prevention-rescue enforcement, risk-based supervision, industry management, technology-enabled monitoring, social co-governance, training and accountability. Not related to AI or robotics beyond a passing mention of AI for monitoring.
